newsitem.title: USA: Siemens Medical gets FDA nod on mammogram.
newsitem.headline: Siemens Medical gets FDA nod on mammogram.

text.p: Siemens Medical Systems Inc, the U.S. affiliate of Siemens AG, said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared its optimized digital mammography system for marketing in the United States.
The system, named Opdima, is designed for use with the Mammomat 3000 Mammography system which provides high levels of image resolution.
According to Siemens, stereotactic biopsies, and biopsy localizations with spot imaging of suspected lesions, can be performed with the Opdima system in less time due to near real-time image display.
